verdict.rationale: Whether uploaded files are used for AI training is a fair privacy question for a cloud file-conversion service. The evidence contains no AI-training opt-out, no no-training commitment, and no data-use policy on model training. The only related claim is file deletion timing, which is a separate retention control and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
